name: Will-o-Wisp
resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious
notes: CR 2. Incorporeal. Ephemeral. Feeds on dying creatures.
gm_notes: Session 4 sacred grove. Ephemeral: can enter solid objects but not end turn inside. Consume Life: when nearby creature drops to 0 HP, wisp gains 10 temp HP. Variable Illumination: adjusts light from 5 ft dim to 20 ft bright. Invisible until it attacks or until its turn ends.
